purpose: Preserve passive high-voltage-energy-management observations separately from promoted signal definitions.

network.name: High Voltage Energy Management High Speed GMLAN
network.note: Interface names such as can0/vcan0 vary by capture. Network identity must come from the session manifest or verified harness configuration, not from the interface name alone.

captures.role: authoritative physical-network provenance plus representative HV payloads
repeated multiplexed cell, temperature and coolant observations

observations.label: multiplexed battery-voltage measurement blocks

atlasObservations.structure: 4 CAN IDs x 8 banks x 3 voltage measurements = 96 voltage measurement slots
atlasObservations.assessment: Decoded values are physically plausible lithium-ion cell voltages and the multiplex structure exactly spans 96 measurements, matching the Gen-1 BECM service inventory.

observations.boundary: The 96 measurement slots are not yet equated to GM GDS2 Hybrid/EV Battery 1-96 numbering or physical pack position. That ordering requires controlled GDS2 cross-validation.

observations.label: multiplexed battery temperature groups
observations.assessment: Two alternating mux groups yield nine temperature channels with physically plausible values across saved captures, matching the nine-temperature/module thermal target in the Gen-1 service inventory.
observations.boundary: Community labels A-I are not yet mapped to exact GM scan-tool sensor/module numbering.

observations.label: battery coolant temperature pair
observations.boundary: The two values are strongly temperature-like. The OpenDBC inlet/outlet labels still require controlled comparison with GM/GDS2 coolant Sensor 1/2 data before Atlas marks the role as confirmed.

observations.label: charger DC output statistics
observations.note: The saved disabled/HV-zero frames independently show a plausible 12-V output rail using the existing corroborated decode.

observations.label: charger requested current/voltage storage

communityDefinition.independentImplementation: Battery-Emulator CHEVY-VOLT-CHARGER.cpp writes byte1=current*20 and bytes2-3=voltage*2

observations.boundary: The stored voltage bytes can decode to a nonsensical value while the charger is disabled. Atlas must not present 0x304 setpoints as meaningful unless the companion 0x30E mode enables the relevant charger output.

observations.label: charger fields intentionally left ambiguous
observations.reason: Available community sources do not agree cleanly enough on their material meaning. Battery-Emulator explicitly treats 0x308 content as unknown, while 0x30A interpretations conflict across sources.
observations.atlasPolicy: Preserve payloads and provenance; do not promote a semantic decode until controlled charging evidence or stronger independent corroboration exists.

globalEvidenceBoundary: No individual positive/negative/precharge/multifunction contactor broadcast state is claimed by these observations.
Pack-current sign/scale remains candidate pending controlled charge/load validation.
Physical network identity is session-specific; never infer it solely from the Linux/Windows interface name.
The 96 multiplexed voltage slots require GDS2 cross-validation before exact GM Battery 1-96 numbering is asserted.
